The following are Hunter's Bonds often taken by Hunters within the city.

### Bounty

Rangers can choose bounty instead of companions or an animal companion with hunter's bond. A ranger with the bounty bond gains the same benefits as a druid but treats their effective druid level as 3 lower than their ranger level. (See [[Seraph Druid Nature's Bonds]])
